figures/fig_a_cluster_sizes.svg.title: Messages per cluster, posts and comments, 5 Aug to 5 Oct 2026
figures/fig_a_cluster_sizes.svg.description: Horizontal bars of the number of posts and comments assigned to each of 18 clusters.

figures/fig_b_daily_share.svg.title: Share of messages per cluster per day (7-day centred mean)
figures/fig_b_daily_share.svg.description: Stacked areas of each cluster share of assigned messages per UTC day, smoothed with a 7-day centred mean; cluster 14 in red.

figures/fig_c_cluster_by_week.svg.title: Cluster share of messages by week (percent of the week)
figures/fig_c_cluster_by_week.svg.description: Heatmap of each cluster share of assigned messages in each of nine weeks, numbers in percent.

figures/fig_d_birth_dates.svg.title: First message, birth and peak date per cluster
figures/fig_d_birth_dates.svg.description: Dot plot per cluster of the date of the first message, the first day with three messages and the peak day of the 7-day mean.

figures/fig_e_concentration.svg.title: Top-3 handle share per cluster (red above 50 percent)
figures/fig_e_concentration.svg.description: Bars of the share of each cluster messages written by its three most frequent handles, with top handle and handle count.

figures/fig_f_answered_1h.svg.title: Share of messages with a reply by another handle within 1 hour
figures/fig_f_answered_1h.svg.description: Bars of the share of messages in each cluster that received a direct reply from another handle within 3600 seconds, with posts and comments marked separately.

figures/fig_g_length.svg.title: Message length, posts and comments
figures/fig_g_length.svg.description: Histogram on a log axis of words per message for 7,806 posts and 94,341 comments.

figures/fig_h_novelty.svg.title: Word types first seen each day (types used in at least 5 messages overall)
figures/fig_h_novelty.svg.description: Bars of the number of word types whose first use falls on each UTC day, and a line of the same count per 1,000 messages that day.

figures/fig_i_handle_by_cluster.svg.title: Share of each top-40 handle messages per cluster
figures/fig_i_handle_by_cluster.svg.description: Heatmap of the 40 handles with most assigned messages against the 18 clusters, cell value the share of that handle messages in the cluster.

figures/fig_j_family_by_cluster.svg.title: Self-declared model family of authors per cluster (labels are unverified)
figures/fig_j_family_by_cluster.svg.description: Stacked horizontal bars of the share of each cluster messages by the self-declared model family of the author.

figures/fig_k_map.svg.title: Map of 20,000 messages (SVD to 50 dimensions, then t-SNE), colour = cluster
figures/fig_k_map.svg.description: Scatter of a random sample of 20,000 messages with at least 20 words in a two-dimensional t-SNE embedding of their TF-IDF vectors, coloured by cluster.

figures/fig_l_top_terms.svg.title: Top 8 NMF terms per cluster
figures/fig_l_top_terms.svg.description: Small multiples of the eight highest-weighted terms of each of 18 clusters.

figures/fig_m_k_selection.svg.title: Coherence and stability by k (chosen k marked)
figures/fig_m_k_selection.svg.description: Lines of mean NPMI coherence and mean matched cosine between independent NMF runs for k from 12 to 30.

figures/fig_n_growth.svg.title: Change in cluster share after day 30 (red above 1.1)
figures/fig_n_growth.svg.description: Bars of the ratio of mean daily share in days 30 to 60 to mean daily share in days 0 to 29 per cluster.
